acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the .claude/agents/ directory, When its contents are listed, Then 7 agent .md files exist: analyst.md, architect.md, backend-engineer.md, frontend-engineer.md, infra-engineer.md, reviewer.md, qa.md.
Given the analyst.md agent definition, When its content is inspected, Then it references the nit:analyze skill and describes the analyst role (analysis, archetype proposal per U-11).
Given each agent definition file, When its allowed-tools section is inspected, Then it lists tools appropriate for that role (e.g., Read/Write/Edit for engineers, Read-only for reviewer).

Given v1 agent files for requirement-gatherer and devops-engineer, When v2 agent definitions are applied, Then requirement-gatherer is replaced by analyst and devops-engineer is replaced by infra-engineer with updated skill references.
